findings.description: The customer-managed KMS key used to encrypt the logs bucket does not set enable_key_rotation, so automatic annual rotation defaults to disabled (as the in-file comment confirms). Long-lived key material that is never rotated increases the window and blast radius of a key compromise, allowing decryption of all historical log data protected by that single key version.
